caribbean.headline: Caribbean Weather: Barbados Faces Heavy Rain, Moderate Winds
caribbean.paragraph: Barbados is experiencing 15 kt winds and 3.9 ft waves, with 75% rain probability. Nassau will see similar 15 kt winds, but lower wave heights.

mediterranean.headline: Dubrovnik Faces Heavy Rain, Calm Seas Today
mediterranean.paragraph: Dubrovnik is experiencing 88% rain probability, calm winds at 0 kt, and modest seas with a 3.9 ft mean wave height and a 5‑second swell period from the west. I observe that Venice, the runner‑up, also has 0‑kt winds and no significant wave activity.
